Committee: Ways and Means Education
Sponsor: Singleton
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 04/26/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 151 as passed the Senate would exempt the Most Worshipful Prince Hall Grand Lodge and Accepted Masons of Alabama and the Most Worshipful Grand Lodge F.&A.M. of Alabama from all state, county, and municipal fees and taxes until September 30, 2026, which would decrease receipts to the Education Trust Fund, State General Fund, Public School Fund, Soldiers Fund, and county and municipal funds and other funds into which local fees and taxes are deposited by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of taxes and fees that would otherwise be collected.
Bill Poole, Chair
Ways and Means Education

Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund
Sponsor: Singleton
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 03/16/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 151 as introduced would exempt the Most Worshipful Prince Hall Grand Lodge and Accepted Masons of Alabama and the Most Worshipful Grand Lodge F.&A.M. of Alabama from all state, county, and municipal fees and taxes, which would decrease receipts to the Education Trust Fund, State General Fund, Public School Fund, Soldiers Fund, and county and municipal funds and other funds into which local fees and taxes are deposited by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of taxes and fees owed that would now not be collected.
Additionally, all exemptions provided in this bill will end on September 30, 2026.
Greg Albritton, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation General Fund
